what: A native-NEAR payout to an account that does not exist fails; the receiver share must stay claimable, not be lost.

steps.step: create_stream 0.2 NEAR over 60s to a receiver account that does not exist yet
sender cancels after ~12s: refund 0.146666… NEAR to sender succeeds; payout 0.053333… NEAR to receiver fails; on_payout restores withdrawn=0
receiver account created, then withdraw pays exactly the restored 0.053333… NEAR
second withdraw rejected: Nothing available to withdraw yet

mainnet: Not upgraded. The mainnet Rust contract (v1) still pays native NEAR with a plain transfer; see README limitations.
